title: DRUM PICKER
question: What if picking a date was a gamble?
note: Three drums, flicked like a slot machine. Spin one gently and it ticks through its detents and settles; spin it hard and the whole picker rattles off its feet and hops toward its own label; shove it the rest of the way and the letters scatter. It will happily land on 31 FEB and mark it with a question mark rather than stop you, which is the opposite of what a date picker is for, and oddly honest about how often we pick a date by feel.
